title: Sri Lankan Delight: Sigiriya, Kandy and Bentota
alt: Sigiriya rock reflected in the lake at dawn
transport: Private air conditioned car with an English speaking chauffeur guide throughout

stops.name: Sigiriya
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Country resort among the paddy fields with the rock on the horizon

activities.name: Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage
activities.description: A stop on the way up from the airport to watch the resident herd bathe in the Maha Oya river and feed at the sanctuary.

program.name: Sigiriya
program.description: Straight from the airport into the Cultural Triangle with the elephants on the way, for a night by the lake under the rock.

stops.name: Kandy
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast and dinner · Deluxe room · 3★ · Deluxe class hotel in the hills above Kandy town

activities.name: Sigiriya rock fortress
activities.description: A full day out to the fifth century rock citadel: the water gardens, the mirror wall, the frescoes and the summit palace ruins.

activities.name: Dambulla cave temple
activities.description: Five rock cut shrines lined with murals and more than a hundred Buddha statues, on the way south to Kandy.

activities.name: Spice garden and Kandyan dance show
activities.description: A stop at a Matale spice garden, then the lake drive and the drummers and fire walkers of the evening show.

activities.name: Full day Kandy city tour
activities.description: The Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, the Peradeniya gardens, the Bahiravokanda Buddha and the gem museum.

program.name: Kandy
program.description: The rock and the Dambulla caves in the morning, then two nights in Kandy with a spice garden, the dance show and a full day of the city.

stops.name: Bentota
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast and dinner · Deluxe room · 3★ · Deluxe class boutique stay a short walk from Bentota beach

activities.name: Madu Ganga boat safari and Kosgoda turtle hatchery
activities.description: A boat through the mangrove islands of the Madu Ganga, then the turtle hatchery at Kosgoda.

activities.name: Excursion to Galle and Mirissa
activities.description: South along the coast to the Dutch fort at Galle with its ramparts and lighthouse, then on to Mirissa beach and Coconut Tree Hill.

program.name: Bentota
program.description: Two nights on the beach with the Madu Ganga boat and the turtle hatchery on arrival, and a day trip to Mirissa and Galle.

stops.name: Colombo
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast and dinner · Deluxe room · 3★ · Historic harbourside hotel in the Colombo Fort district

activities.name: Full day Colombo sightseeing
activities.description: Galle Face Green, the Gangaramaya temple, the colonial Fort district, the Lotus Tower and the floating market at Pettah.

program.name: Colombo
program.description: A final night in the Fort district with a full day of the capital.

day_titles.1: Arrival in Colombo and on to Sigiriya
day_titles.2: Sigiriya, Dambulla and on to Kandy
day_titles.4: To Bentota: Madu Ganga and the turtles

1: Arrival at Bandaranaike International and private transfer inland
A stop at the Pinnawala elephant sanctuary on the way
Check in by the lake with the rock on the horizon
2: An early climb of the Sigiriya rock fortress
Breakfast, then the Dambulla cave temple
A spice garden at Matale on the way south
Check in at Kandy, a lake drive and the dance show
3: Breakfast, then the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
The hilltop Buddha at Bahiravokanda and the gem museum
4: Breakfast and a transfer down to the south west coast
A boat safari through the Madu Ganga mangroves
Check in at Bentota and the evening on the beach
5: Breakfast and an excursion along the southern coast
Mirissa beach and Coconut Tree Hill
The Galle Dutch fort: ramparts, lighthouse and old church
6: Breakfast and a transfer down the coast to Colombo
Galle Face Green and the Gangaramaya temple complex
The Fort district, the Lotus Tower and Pettah market
Dinner and your last night at the hotel
7: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Bandaranaike International for your flight home

expert.name: Aditya
expert.role: Sri Lanka expert at Hi Tours
expert.quote: Kandy, the hills and then the coast. Sri Lanka works best when you let the island cool you down before it warms you up again.
expert.tip: Carry a light sweater for Nuwara Eliya. It sits at nearly 1,900 metres and evenings are surprisingly chilly even in April.

summary: Seven days in the classic order: a night under Sigiriya rock, the Dambulla caves, two nights in Kandy with the dance show, two on the beach at Bentota with the Madu Ganga and Galle, and a final night in Colombo.
included: Included: 6 nights in standard and deluxe class hotels with breakfast and lunch or dinner daily (breakfast only in Sigiriya); private airport transfers and all road travel in an air conditioned car with chauffeur guide; the Pinnawala elephant sanctuary visit; the Sigiriya excursion and the Dambulla cave temple; a spice garden visit; Kandy lake drive and Kandyan dance show; a full day Kandy city tour; the Madu Ganga boat safari and Kosgoda turtle hatchery; a day excursion to Mirissa and Galle; full day Colombo sightseeing.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Sri Lanka ETA visa fees; lunches unless stated; entrance tickets where marked as payable locally; travel insurance; optional excursions; tips and personal expenses.
